title: update_read_at allows backward timestamp regression
description: update_read_at executes UPDATE messages SET read_at = ?1 unconditionally; a second Peer/receipt(read) arriving with an earlier local clock value silently overwrites a later read_at. update_delivery_state has a terminal-state SQL guard (delivery_state \!= 'delivered') but update_read_at has no equivalent monotonicity guard (WHERE read_at IS NULL OR read_at < ?1). In Phase 1 now_unix is monotonically increasing but there is no DB-layer enforcement.
